title: Explorer unit classification
responsibility: Assigns units to readable explorer categories and role names.

inputs.name: explorerCategory.unit
inputs.description: Unit kind, owned source files and selected-revision declaration proof to classify or label.

inputs.name: explorerRole.unit
inputs.description: Unit kind, owned source files and selected-revision declaration proof to classify or label.

outputs.name: explorerCategory
outputs.description: Rendering routes are Pages. Source-declared persisted data wrappers are Models; existing shared interface and alias modules are Types. Helpers require purity and two distinct runtime consumers. Unproven or internal modules have no collection.

outputs.name: explorerRole
outputs.description: Page for rendering routes, Route loader for non-rendering route kinds, otherwise a known friendly role or words derived from the kind.
